findings.evidence: plan.md:11-22 correctly identifies the main contradiction and a minimal 2-node/1-edge public-wheel action, but plan.md:143-162 places the VALUE milestone after Task 1 implements all three kinds and Task 2 completes the full invalid-kind/type/self-loop, cross-principal, stale/conflict/suppression, every-fault-seam, replay and reopen matrix. supports and relates_to plus the full defensive matrix are not direct dependencies of the approved applies_to value action.
findings.root_cause: The stated primary contradiction is genuinely the deciding user-value problem and the stated smoke is minimal, but task batching places full protocol breadth and defenses before that value can be demonstrated.

findings.evidence: acceptance.md:64 and acceptance.md:75-77 prohibit physical deletion by maintenance or test helpers from the first prototype evidence onward. plan.md:196-200 defines rollback as discarding the fresh prototype database while simultaneously claiming evidence is not deleted, without restricting discard to synthetic spike databases that can never contain protected evidence.
findings.root_cause: Rollback is defined at whole-database granularity without separating disposable synthetic test state from protected append-only prototype evidence.

findings.evidence: Current sqlite_v5.py:6462-6466 emits SUPPRESS evolution lineage as relates_to. plan.md:84-103 both promises existing evolution behavior and changes the evolution kind to suppresses. relation_domain already disambiguates evolution relates_to from knowledge relates_to, so the rename is not required by the approved knowledge-relation increment and has no frozen compatibility/replay oracle.
findings.root_cause: The plan mixes the new knowledge-relation discriminator with an unrelated mutation-lineage vocabulary change.

findings.evidence: plan.md:108-126 requires stable reason codes and decision/audit receipts for v4 or unknown wire and malformed dependency payloads, but the flow reaches MemoryManager only after the Harness strict parser. Tasks 1-6 assign no durable Host-side audit owner or evidence oracle for parser failures that cannot produce a valid MemoryMutationPlan. Existing sqlite_v5.py:6816-6845 records rejection audit only after backend apply has been entered.
findings.root_cause: Audit ownership is specified only generically across a trust boundary where pre-parser failures and post-admission mutation rejections require different durable recording authorities.

findings.evidence: The current TC-HM-12 rev2 remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED because its public seed contract is pending. plan.md:157-162 first upgrades its fixture/runner after Harness and Memory implementation, while plan.md:172-176 freezes and repins the oracle still later. This permits the black-box expected contract and assertions to be derived from the completed implementation rather than frozen before it; only candidate identity hashes inherently need post-build repinning.
findings.root_cause: Oracle semantics, runner implementation, and candidate artifact pinning are treated as one late task instead of freezing behavior independently before production implementation.
